payload.reason: The evidence provides specific existing approaches for representing geographic locations using embeddings, including methods that utilize photo-sharing metadata and various machine learning techniques.

claims.text: One approach uses metadata from photo-sharing websites like Flickr to create bag-of-words descriptions of geographic locations, which are integrated with structured information.
Another approach involves using principal component analysis and stacked autoencoders to learn low-dimensional vector representations of city neighborhoods based on census data.
Some works combine word embedding models with geographic coordinates to learn word embeddings based on geographic location similarities.
